scope: fixed20 calibration only, current image and combined objectives, no new loss
main_metric: COCO box AP IoU .50:.95, all 20 IDs
objective: image MSE + lambda*latent_rate/original_pixels + machine_weight*feature_L1; final network bits included in reported bpp
lambda_direction: larger lambda penalizes rate more strongly
combined_lambda_selection: Use measured total bpp only; choose nearest target among bracket or log-lambda interpolation between adjacent bracket points; never AP selection
retry_policy: No outcome-based retries; preserve raw attempts; environmental failures retained and only explicit corrected attempts
interpolation_policy: No AP interpolation in initial report; unmatched measured points remain unmatched; no extrapolation
old_c3_missing_artifacts: All three image conditions and combined .0003/.001 have JSON only; do not silently relax exact detector metadata validation
